title: Cheesy Vego Loaded Wedges
subtitle: with Corn and Smashed Avo
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Check your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe (see Kitchen hack). Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut the unpeeled potatoes into wedges. Cut the capsicum into 3cm chunks. Finely chop the tomato. Discard the husk and silks from the corn, then slice the kernels from the cob. Coarsely grate the cheese.

Roast wedges: Put the potato on the lined tray, drizzle with 1 tbs olive oil and scatter with half the barbecue seasoning. Season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast for 20-25 mins until golden and tender.

Cook capsicum and corn: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the capsicum and corn kernels, stirring occasionally, for 6-8 mins until the capsicum is tender. Add the remaining barbecue seasoning and 1 tbs barbecue sauce and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until combined. Remove the pan from the heat.
Finish wedges: Spoon the capsicum mixture and half the tomato over the potato wedges. Scatter over the cheese. Roast for a further 5-7 mins until the cheese is melted.

Serve up: Meanwhile, coarsely mash the avocado in a bowl. Stir in 1 tsp white wine vinegar and season with salt and pepper. Dollop the smashed avocado over the cheesy wedges, scatter over the remaining tomato and enjoy!

Kitchen hack: To speed up the ripening process, put the avocado in a paper bag and close loosely, then leave on the kitchen bench for a day or two. Add a banana to the bag to make the avocado ripen faster.
